baseline.balanced_low_goal: balanced and FormalV2 matrix expected total goals<2.5
baseline.balanced_open: balanced and FormalV2 matrix expected total goals>=2.5
baseline.primary: V3.1.1-A frozen prediction/matrix from stress artifact
baseline.strong_weak_identity: Formal V2 pre-match home-vs-away probability ordering; actual result never defines identity

candidates.description: Symmetric strong/draw/weak multinomial residual calibration on top of frozen V3.1.1 probabilities. Allows both strong and weak probabilities to move; no new football event features.
candidates.matrix_rule: I-project frozen V3.1.1 15x15 matrix by home/draw/away outcome regions to candidate 1X2; within-region score shape unchanged.
candidates.optimizer: offset multinomial Newton with ridge; max 25 iterations; deterministic backtracking line search

candidates.description: Candidate A plus development-residualized pre-match shot-process structure, fitted as an incremental multinomial residual head. Designed to test information not already explained by baseline probabilities/expected total.
candidates.fallback: process profile unavailable -> exact selected Candidate A prediction/matrix
candidates.matrix_rule: I-project frozen V3.1.1 15x15 matrix by outcome regions to candidate 1X2; within-region score shape unchanged.
candidates.optimizer: offset multinomial Newton with ridge; max 25 iterations; deterministic backtracking line search

candidates.cell_statistics: per-match standardized total-goal count around frozen matrix expected total and standardized centered home*away covariance term; region-wise normalization preserves 1X2 exactly
candidates.description: Outcome-mass preserving exact-score calibration only. Within each home/draw/away region, apply a two-statistic exponential tilt for total-goal level and home-away covariance/dependence; 1X2 remains frozen V3.1.1 exactly.

combination_rule: No first-batch candidate combines outcome residual and score-shape modules. A later research version may combine the selected outcome candidate with C only if the first-batch ablation shows the outcome candidate materially improves 1X2 while C materially improves conditional score structure under their frozen gates; no post-result gate relaxation.

data_roles.note: Both seasons were previously exposed in V3.1.1 stress/diagnostic work; 2025/26 is not untouched or fresh confirmation. Candidate definitions and grids are frozen before any new-candidate scores are read.

features.candidate_B_redundancy_control: Each incremental raw feature is linearly residualized on development against the common baseline features before multinomial residual fitting; the residualizer is then frozen and applied to evaluation. Incremental value is B versus A on the same rows.
features.missing_semantics: No text inference or imputation from target match. Candidate B uses exact Candidate A prediction when pre-match process profile is unavailable.

selection.A: lowest 2024/25 1X2 LogLoss among grid fits subject to weak-upset calibration_abs_error not worse than V3.1.1 by >0.005 and strong-win binary LogLoss nondegrade; tie -> larger lambda
selection.B: lowest 2024/25 1X2 LogLoss among grid fits subject to weak-upset ROC-AUC >= Candidate A -0.002 and calibration_abs_error <= Candidate A +0.005; tie -> larger lambda
selection.C: lowest 2024/25 conditional-score-given-outcome LogLoss subject to total-goals Brier/RPS not worse than V3.1.1 by >0.0005 and each 0-0/1-1/2-2 binary Brier not worse by >0.001; tie -> smaller abs(alpha)+abs(beta), then lexical
